diagnosisRequirements.description: Moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis
diagnosisRequirements.evidenceText: Diagnosis of moderately to severely active rheumatoid arthritis

stepTherapy.failureCriteria: inadequate response, contraindication, or clinically significant adverse effects
stepTherapy.evidenceText: History of failure to a 3 month trial of one non-biologic disease modifying anti-rheumatic drug (DMARD) [e.g., methotrexate, leflunomide, sulfasalazine, hydroxychloroquine] at the maximally indicated doses, unless contraindicated or clinically significant adverse effects are experienced

otherRequirements.requirement: Prescribed by or in consultation with a rheumatologist
otherRequirements.evidenceText: Prescribed by or in consultation with a rheumatologist

otherRequirements.requirement: Patient is not receiving adalimumab in combination with another systemic targeted immunomodulator for treatment of the same indication
otherRequirements.evidenceText: Patient is not receiving adalimumab in combination with another systemic targeted immunomodulator. [e.g., Enbrel (etanercept), Cimzia (certolizumab), Simponi (golimumab), Orencia (abatacept), Xeljanz (tofacitinib), Olumiant (baricitinib), Rinvoq (upadacitinib)] for treatment of the same indication.

otherRequirements.requirement: For Connecticut, Kentucky and Mississippi business: 30-day trial required instead of 3-month trial
otherRequirements.evidenceText: For Connecticut, Kentucky and Mississippi business only a 30-day trial will be required.
